business_scope.primary_industry_name: Manufacture of Biocompatible Dental Ceramic Blocks and Milling Discs

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Economic Cooperation Framework Agreement (ECFA) between the Association for Relations Across the Taiwan Straits and the Straits Exchange Foundation (signed 29 June 2010, effective 12 September 2010)
Cross-Strait Investment Protection and Promotion Agreement (signed 31 August 2012, effective 1 February 2013)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: PRC Anti-Money Laundering Law (revised 25 June 2024, effective 1 January 2025); PBOC/SAMR Order No. 3, Measures for the Administration of Beneficial Owner Information of Legal Persons and Other Organizations (promulgated 23 August 2024, effective 1 November 2024); and the relevant provisions of the PRC Foreign Investment Law and the Regulations on the Administration of Enterprise Names.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation / Company Registration Certificate of the Taiwan, China investing shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company and Commerce Registration Bureau, Ministry of Economic Affairs, Taiwan, China
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Step 1: Taiwan district notary office notarization. Step 2: Verification by the Straits Exchange Foundation (SEF). Step 3: Confirmation/authentication by the Association for Relations Across the Taiwan Straits (ARATS) in the PRC. If the issuing jurisdiction is an Apostille Convention member state, use the Hague Apostille stamp only; if the issuing jurisdiction is a non-member state, use consular legalization only through the PRC embassy or consulate. Apostille and consular legalization are parallel, mutually exclusive alternatives and must never be chained.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Certificate of Continuous Registration
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company and Commerce Registration Bureau, Ministry of Economic Affairs, Taiwan, China
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Use the same mutually exclusive authentication path as the Certificate of Incorporation: Taiwan notarization and SEF/ARATS cross-strait verification; for Apostille Convention member states, issue the Hague Apostille alone; for non-member controlling jurisdictions, complete PRC consular legalization alone. Apostille and consular legalization must not be combined sequentially.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution of the Investing Corporation Authorizing Formation of the PRC WFOE and Executed Power of Attorney
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of Directors of the Taiwan, China investing corporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: The board resolution and Power of Attorney must be notarized in the Taiwan, China issuing district, verified by the Straits Exchange Foundation, and confirmed by ARATS. For entities from Apostille Convention member states, attach the Hague Apostille issued by the designated competent authority; for non-member states, complete PRC consular legalization at the PRC embassy or consulate. Apostille and consular legalization are non-sequential alternatives and must never be chained.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association / Memorandum and Articles of the Taiwan, China Investing Corporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Taiwan, China investing corporation, certified by its statutory representative and registered company secretary or attorney
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarize the certified copy in the Taiwan, China notary office, then complete SEF verification and ARATS confirmation for PRC use. If the issuing jurisdiction is an Apostille Convention contracting state, attach a Hague Apostille; if the issuing jurisdiction is a non-member state, use PRC consular legalization. These two authentication paths are mutually exclusive and must not be chained.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter / Credit Standing Letter from the Investor's Principal Bank
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Taiwan, China commercial bank holding the investor's primary settlement account
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: The bank reference letter must be notarized by the issuing bank or a Taiwan notary after bank officer signature, followed by SEF verification and ARATS confirmation. If the issuing bank is in an Apostille Convention member state, attach a Hague Apostille; if in a non-member bank jurisdiction, use PRC consular legalization. Apostille and consular legalization are mutually exclusive; do not chain both.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: UBO Declaration Form and Organization Structure Chart of the Investor for PBOC/SAMR Order No. 3 Filing
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Taiwan, China investing corporation and its ultimate beneficial owner(s)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: The signed UBO declaration and organization structure chart must be notarized in Taiwan, China, verified by SEF, and confirmed by ARATS for PBOC/SAMR Order No. 3 filing. Alternatively, a Hague Apostille must be obtained if the issuing jurisdiction is an Apostille Convention member state; if the issuing jurisdiction is a non-member state, PRC consular legalization must be obtained. Apostille and consular legalization are independent paths and must never be chained.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of every director, shareholder, ultimate beneficial owner, legal representative, supervisor, and senior manager against the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, PRC PBOC sanctions and money-laundering risk list, and the Taiwan Financial Supervisory Commission AML blacklist. PEP screening must apply FATF 40 Recommendations and identify domestic and foreign politically exposed persons; any match requires enhanced due diligence, senior management approval, and suspicious transaction reporting. Ongoing monitoring must be repeated at least every 180 days and upon any material ownership change.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: SAMR National Enterprise Registration Service Online Platform and the local Administration for Market Regulation one-stop licensing portal for WFOE name pre-clearance and incorporation
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The registered corporate name must be in simplified Chinese characters. A foreign-invested enterprise may also use a corresponding English company name, which must be a faithful translation or phonetic transliteration of the Chinese name. The mandatory four-tier naming structure consists of: optional administrative division, distinctive trade name, industry or business characteristics, and organization type. Any transliteration must be recorded in the business license and must not conflict with existing registered names, trademarks, or geographical indications.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon a name-rejection decision by SAMR, the applicant or entrusted formation agent must file a written administrative reconsideration application with the next-higher Administration for Market Regulation within 60 days of receipt of the written rejection decision, stating the legal basis and the correction of prohibited tokens or conflicting names. If the SAMR fails to respond within the statutory timeframe, the applicant may treat that silence as a rejection and file a further petition. As a last resort, an administrative lawsuit may be brought in the relevant People's Court within 6 months. The UBO and legal counsel should simultaneously submit a modified four-tier name preserving the trade-mark value while avoiding conflict, since a new reservation period then starts.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office, home office, or commercial-mailbox-only address is not acceptable for the PRC WFOE in ISIC 3250 dental ceramic block manufacturing. The SAMR business license, the State Taxation Administration tax registration, the Customs registration, and the local dental consumables production license all require a physical registered office and production site with a verified lease or ownership certificate, a valid business-site map, and actual personnel and inventory presence. Banks under PBOC KYC standards will reject a commercial-mailbox address for opening a corporate settlement account, especially for a foreign-invested manufacturing entity. Therefore, a full-service physical office in an industrial park or a class-B scientific building is mandatory.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Inspection checklist: (1) lease and property rights certificate; (2) physical production equipment and zirconia block or disc milling lines; (3) environmental and fire-safety compliance; (4) employee attendance and labor contracts; (5) raw material inventory and purchase invoices; (6) sales contracts and export/import records. Quantified risk: high, estimated at 70-80% likelihood of an unannounced on-site inspection by the municipal SAMR and tax bureau within the first 12 months of operation, because manufacturing WFOEs are a priority audit category and dental medical-device consumables trigger the National Medical Products Administration supervision protocol.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Unified Social Credit Code and tax registration certificate
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: State Taxation Administration and local tax bureau
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory official fee nil; tax registration is bundled with the SAMR business license issuance.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO information filing under PBOC/SAMR Order No. 3

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: No official filing fee; regulator does not charge for UBO declaration submission.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and cross-strait verification bundle for Taiwan, China investor documents

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Tariff-based notary fees plus SEF/ARATS service charges as published; market benchmark for a corporate document package.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Retained PRC law firm / cross-border corporate counsel
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for WFOE formation in major cities such as Shanghai, Hangzhou, or Shenzhen; quoted as fixed fee or hourly equivalent.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Company seal engraving set including legal representative, finance, invoice, and contract seals
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market rate per registered seal set under local public security price guidance.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Bank reference letter issuance fee from the Taiwan, China investor's principal bank

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Published commercial bank service tariff for credit reference or good-standing letter issuance.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for corporate settlement account opening, KYC compliance support, and liaison with PBOC-reporting bank.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2018 Revision), Articles 23, 24, 26, 29-31, 40, 46, 50-54; Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China (2019, effective 2020), Articles 2, 4, 6, 10, 12, 15, 28-30 and 34; Regulations on Special Administrative Measures for Foreign Investment Access (Negative List, 2021 Edition), applicable manufacturing categories; Regulations on the Registration Administration of Market Entities (State Council Order No. 746); Interim Measures for the Registration of Foreign-Invested Enterprises (SAMR); Law of the People's Republic of China on the Protection of Investment by Taiwan Compatriots and its Implementing Rules; Measures for the Administration of Medical Device Production (NMPA Order No. 53).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) and the local Municipal or District Market Supervision Administration having territorial jurisdiction over the proposed registered office; foreign investment information filing is made through the Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM) Foreign Investment Comprehensive Management Service System.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Establishment Registration of a Foreign-Invested Limited Liability Company (SAMR Form), together with the verified Articles of Association, the Statement of Shareholder and Officer Information, and the Notice of Pre-Approval of Company Name.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: None. No statutory minimum paid-up capital or blocked escrow account requirement applies to a Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise (WFOE) under current PRC law. The registered capital amount and contribution schedule are determined by the shareholder in the Articles of Association. The Taiwan investor may contribute in RMB or eligible foreign currency through approved banking channels, and the contribution must be received by the company before the expiry of the contribution period specified in the Articles of Association. For the proposed dental zirconia block manufacturing activity, the relevant NMPA production license does not impose a minimum capital threshold, but the facility, equipment, and quality system must be commensurate with the declared registered scope.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTIONS OF THE FIRST MEETING OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF [COMPANY NAME] LIMITED (THE 'COMPANY') The undersigned directors, being all duly appointed directors of the Company, hereby waive formal notice of a meeting and, acting pursuant to Article [___] of the Articles of Association and the Company Law of the People's Republic of China, adopt the following resolutions by unanimous written consent with full force and effect as if taken at a duly constituted meeting of the Board of Directors. 1. SHARE CAPITAL SUBSCRIPTION. The Board acknowledges and approves the subscription by the sole shareholder, [TAIWAN INVESTOR], to the entire registered capital of the Company in the amount of RMB [AMOUNT], allocated as [NUMBER] contribution units. The legal representative is instructed to issue a capital contribution notice in accordance with the payment schedule in the Articles of Association, demand contribution no later than the due date, and deposit all funds into the Company's dedicated capital account. 2. BANKING AUTHORIZATION. The Board approves the opening of a bank account at [BANK] located at [BRANCH] and any additional RMB or foreign currency accounts required for operations. The Board designates [DIRECTOR A] and [SUPERVISOR B] as authorized signatories, with any two signatures required for all payments, transfers, mandates, and instructions. The banking mandate is effective immediately, and the advisers of the Company are authorized to deliver the banking resolution and specimen signatures to the selected bank. 3. REGISTERED OFFICE ADOPTION. The Board adopts the premises located at [LAWFUL REGISTERED OFFICE ADDRESS] as the Company's registered office, seat of management, and address for service of process in the People's Republic of China. The legal representative is authorized to execute the lease, pay rental deposits, and register the address with the Market Supervision Administration and tax authorities. 4. STATUTORY OFFICER APPOINTMENTS. The Board appoints [EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR] as Executive Director and General Manager, acting as the legal representative of the Company, with full authority to bind the Company and sign all statutory filings. The Board appoints [SUPERVISOR] as Supervisor for a term of three years, with the duties and powers prescribed by law. The Board appoints [REGULATORY OFFICER] as Regulatory and Quality Director, responsible for obtaining the Medical Device Production License, product registration, environmental permits, and maintaining compliance with the National Medical Products Administration. 5. GENERAL AUTHORITY AND IMPLEMENTATION. The General Manager is authorized and directed to take all acts necessary to register the Company, obtain official company chops, open tax and social insurance records, file the foreign investment information report, and negotiate and execute all ancillary documents. These resolutions are effective when signed by all directors and may be executed in counterparts.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Name Pre-Approval and Business Scope Screening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: SAMR National Enterprise Registration Online Service Platform and the local District/Municipal Market Supervision Administration with jurisdiction over the proposed registered office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an online application for pre-approval of the company name in Chinese, together with the proposed pinyin/English transliteration and a business scope description covering manufacturing of dental ceramic blocks and milling discs under ISIC 3250. The system will screen the name for conflicts with existing enterprises, trademarks, and prohibited characters. If the proposed name is available, the authority issues a Notice of Pre-Approval of Company Name, valid for six months. In parallel, confirm with the local medical products administration that the dental CAD/CAM zirconia block product is a Class II or Class III medical device, because the product classification will determine the exact wording of the licensed business scope and the required production license.
required_dossiers: Three to five proposed Chinese company names with English transliterations
Passport or Taiwan-region investor identification certificate (copy)
Proposed business scope in Chinese using SAMR standard vocabulary
Power of attorney if filed through an agent
Application form for company name pre-approval
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for duplication or prohibited wording, file a fresh name application with a more distinctive trade name or submit a written explanation. If the system suspends the application on foreign investment negative-list grounds, request a written preliminary opinion from the local commerce department. If the rejection is due to electronic authentication failure, re-validate the CA certificate and resubmit the application.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Cross-Strait Notarization and Verification of Taiwan Investor Documents and Execution of Constitutional Instruments
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary office in Taiwan authorized by the Straits Exchange Foundation (SEF), the mainland notary association receiving the notarized instrument, and the company's legal counsel for drafting the Articles of Association.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Obtain notarized copies of the Taiwan investor's business registration certificate and investor identification documents, then transmit the notarized instrument through the SEF to the designated mainland notary association for cross-strait verification. Upon receipt of the verification certificate, execute the Articles of Association, the shareholder's written resolution, the first board resolution, the legal representative appointment certificate, and the supervisor consent letter. All instruments must be in Chinese, with an English version for corporate records, and the Chinese text will govern. The Articles of Association must state the registered capital, contribution schedule, business scope, governance structure, representative designation, and change procedures. If any signature is executed outside mainland China, it must be notarized or witnessed in accordance with the cross-strait notarization rules.
required_dossiers: Notarized Taiwan business registration certificate and investor identity documents
Straits Exchange Foundation transmitting letter and mainland notary verification certificate
Draft Articles of Association in Chinese
Capital contribution schedule and shareholder payment undertaking
Registered office lease agreement or property ownership document
Passport or identity document of each director, supervisor, and legal representative
Consent to act letters signed by all directors, the supervisor, and the legal representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the SEF or receiving mainland notary association issues a defective or incomplete verification, require the investor to obtain a fresh notarized duplicate or apply for a second verification. If the Articles of Association are challenged as non-standard, revise the clauses against the SAMR template and re-execute before notarization. If the lease cannot be verified, provide the building ownership certificate and floor plan.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Establishment Registration with the Market Supervision Administration and Issuance of Business License
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local District/Municipal Market Supervision Administration through the SAMR E-Registration portal or the onsite comprehensive service window.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the completed establishment application, the verified Articles of Association, the name pre-approval notice, the shareholder's qualification certificate, the consent letters, and the registered address documents. The registration authority reviews the application, verifies the identity of the legal representative and supervisor, and issues the Business License carrying the Unified Social Credit Code. After issuance, register the company's official seal, financial seal, invoice seal, and legal representative seal with the public security system. No later than 30 days after establishment, make the initial foreign investment information filing through the MOFCOM Foreign Investment Comprehensive Management Service System, as the Taiwan investment is treated under the same registration framework as foreign investment for operational licensing purposes.
required_dossiers: Signed Application for Establishment Registration of a Foreign-Invested Limited Liability Company
Verified Articles of Association in two copies
Notice of Pre-Approval of Company Name
Taiwan shareholder qualification certificate and SEF verification certificate
Identity documents and consent letters of directors, supervisor, and legal representative
Lease agreement and certificate of property title or landlord's written consent
Power of attorney if appointed an agent
Commitment letter on the authenticity of submitted documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If SAMR issues a deficiency notice, cure the defect within 10 working days by submitting corrected documents. If the registered office is rejected because the landlord title is insufficient, supply an amended lease and a verified property ownership certificate. If the business scope wording is considered imprecise, resubmit the scope using the SAMR standardized business scope dictionary.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax, Banking, Social Insurance, and Post-Incorporation Statutory Filings
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: State Taxation Administration and local tax service office, the selected commercial bank with RMB and foreign currency account capability, the local social insurance and housing provident fund authorities, and MOFCOM for foreign investment information filing.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Use the Business License and Unified Social Credit Code to complete tax registration, obtain the electronic invoice system, and register for corporate income tax, value-added tax, and payroll withholding. Open a basic deposit account and a foreign currency capital contribution account at a licensed bank, and file the board's banking authorization and specimen signatures. Register with social insurance and housing provident fund authorities and file employee information. Submit the foreign investment information filing through the MOFCOM system and retain the filing receipt. For the dental ceramics manufacturing activity, ensure the tax registration includes the proper manufacturing category and prepare the separate NMPA licensing dossiers before any production begins. All capital amounts remitted from the Taiwan investor must substantiate the capital contribution declaration in the Articles of Association.
required_dossiers: Business License and Unified Social Credit Code certificate
Seal registration certificate and official seal specimens
Legal representative identity certificate
Board resolution on banking authorization and bank mandate forms
RMB basic deposit account and foreign currency account opening documents
Tax registration and invoice system application forms
Social insurance registration and housing provident fund registration forms
MOFCOM foreign investment information filing receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank rejects the account opening on KYC or AML grounds, provide an updated source-of-funds statement, audited financial statements of the Taiwan investor, and a final beneficial ownership declaration. If tax registration is queried due to data mismatch, correct the Business License or legal representative identity record before resubmission. If the foreign investment information filing receives a query, submit a supplementary response through the MOFCOM system within 15 working days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: National Medical Products Administration (NMPA) and the provincial/regional Medical Products Administration; Ministry of Ecology and Environment (MEE) and the local Ecology and Environment Bureau; local Fire and Rescue Division; local Health Commission for occupational health supervision.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Medical Device Production License (Class II/III), Medical Device Registration Certificate for the dental CAD/CAM zirconia ceramic block product, Pollutant Discharge Permit where required, Fire Protection Acceptance Certificate or Record Filing, and Occupational Hazard Project Registration.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Ecology and Environment of the People's Republic of China (MEE) and the competent provincial/municipal Ecology and Environment Bureau.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Environmental Registration Form (Category III) is generally sufficient for small-scale machining and sintering operations with negligible pollutant generation; an Environmental Impact Report Form (Category II) is required where the project involves significant firing, dust, gas, or wastewater discharge. A full Environmental Impact Report (Category I) is not expected for ISIC 3250 dental zirconia block manufacturing. The applicable tier is confirmed by reference to the current Classification Management List of Environmental Impact Assessments for Construction Projects.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater: direct discharge into natural waters must meet GB 8978-1996 Level 1, including pH 6-9, COD not exceeding 100 mg/L, BOD5 not exceeding 30 mg/L, SS not exceeding 70 mg/L, and ammonia nitrogen not exceeding 15 mg/L; indirect discharge into a municipal wastewater system must meet the local sewer access standards or GB/T 31962-2015, typically COD not exceeding 500 mg/L, BOD5 not exceeding 300 mg/L, SS not exceeding 400 mg/L, and ammonia nitrogen not exceeding 45 mg/L. Air emissions: particulate matter not exceeding 120 mg/m3 and non-methane total hydrocarbons not exceeding 120 mg/m3 under GB 16297-1996, with emission stacks at least 15 meters high and dust collection efficiency of at least 95 percent. Hazardous waste must be stored and labeled per GB 18597-2023, transferred through the electronic manifest system, and disposed of at a licensed facility within the statutory time limit.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Protection Design Review and Fire Protection Final Acceptance Certificate or Record Filing for the factory premises must be obtained from the local Fire and Rescue Division before production begins. The civil defense obligation is limited to the construction of any underground or basement space and is confirmed with the local civil defense office. Structural load inspections must be certified by a licensed engineer for areas carrying sintering furnaces, milling machines, and dense zirconia block storage racks. Occupational health requirements include registration of the project with the local Health Commission, workplace monitoring for respirable dust, noise and heat stress under GBZ 2.1-2019 and GBZ 2.2-2007, provision of approved personal protective equipment, pre-employment and periodic medical examinations, and implementation of a safety production management system under the Work Safety Law.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) of the People's Republic of China; online registration and compliance are performed through the STA Electronic Tax Bureau (e-Tax Bureau) platform and the national VAT invoice management system.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Incorporate the WFOE as a limited liability company with the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) and obtain the business license bearing the Unified Social Credit Code (USCC), which is the statutory taxpayer identification number (TIN) of the enterprise. Step 2: Tax registration occurs automatically under the integrated one-license-one-code reform; no separate VAT registration number is issued. Step 3: Within 30 days of the business license, activate the e-Tax Bureau account, complete the taxpayer profile (legal representative, financial accounts, accounting and bookkeeping arrangements, investor details), and confirm the competent local STA office. Step 4: For export activity, complete the GACC Customs Registration for Import/Export Enterprises and complete the export tax rebate (exemption) filing registration in the e-Tax Bureau. Step 5: A foreign non-resident enterprise without an establishment in China is assigned a non-resident TIN by the STA when it registers for withholding and tax filing obligations.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. The PRC does not provide check-the-box or similar entity classification elections; a WFOE is automatically a resident enterprise subject to entity-level Enterprise Income Tax on worldwide income. No elective hybrid mismatch regime is available.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value-Added Tax (VAT) under the PRC Value-Added Tax Law and its implementing regulations, administered by the State Taxation Administration.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No turnover threshold applies to WFOE VAT registration; every enterprise must be tax/VAT registered when the SAMR business license is issued. The statutory classification threshold for mandatory general VAT taxpayer status is RMB 5,000,000 of annual taxable sales; below that level a taxpayer is eligible for small-scale VAT status unless general status is elected.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Under the STA Golden Tax and fully digitalized electronic invoice system, all VAT invoices (Special VAT Invoices and Ordinary VAT Invoices) must be issued through STA-approved fiscal invoice platforms or the e-Tax Bureau digital invoice service. Each invoice carries a unique invoice code and number, and invoice data are transmitted to the national VAT invoice management and verification system for near-real-time validation. The STA applies automated anti-fraud screening and reconciles invoice flows against customs export

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: People's Bank of China (PBOC) and State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Mainland China is not a jurisdiction with full capital-account convertibility. The current account is generally convertible for genuine trade, services, and dividend remittances when the underlying transaction is verified by a licensed bank; the capital account is subject to case-by-case SAFE registration or approval. A Taiwan-owned WFOE must first complete FDI foreign exchange registration at the appointed bank, open a foreign exchange capital account, and only then receive equity funds from its Taiwanese shareholder. The RMB conversion of the capital injection is legal only for the WFOE's own operational purposes supported by invoices and business contracts. Export proceeds are no longer subject to mandatory surrender; however, they must be repatriated to China within the prescribed time period and may be retained in a foreign-currency settlement account or converted to RMB voluntarily. Profit remittance to the Taiwanese parent is permitted after the WFOE has paid or externally withheld corporate income tax and other taxes; the remitting bank will require the audited financial statements, tax payment certificates, the foreign exchange registration code, and a clear board resolution declaring dividends. Liquidation proceeds remittance requires SAFE deregistration and tax clearance. These controls make bank selection and documentation discipline critical.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Goods exports: proceeds must be repatriated to mainland China within 90 days from the date of customs export declaration, or within the commercial settlement period for open-account trade, in no case exceeding 90 days unless a deferred collection registration is made with SAFE's Trade Monitoring System. Mandatory conversion ratio: 0 percent; there is currently no fixed percentage of export proceeds that must be converted into RMB. Enterprises may retain 100 percent of foreign exchange in an export proceeds account or sell it to a designated bank at their discretion. Trade-in-services and cross-border e-commerce receipts follow separate SAFE codes but are also subject to repatriation to the domestic entity's account.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Basic Operational RMB and Foreign Currency Settlement Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (ICBC)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: FDI Foreign Exchange Capital Account and RMB Capital Verification Account
Trade Settlement and Export Collection Current Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility: Low. Under current PRC rules, a WFOE must use a bank authorized by SAFE/PBOC to receive capital injections, settle FX, pay import duties, and collect export proceeds. Offshore digital EMI licensees such as virtual banks and e-money institutions do not hold a mainland banking licence and cannot maintain CNY basic deposits or provide SAFE-compliant FX current and capital account clearing. They may not obtain the foreign exchange registration code or manage FX purpose-of-payment codes. Their legal position is limited to serving as an ancillary payment wallet for small cross-border e-commerce where the money is ultimately routed through a licensed domestic third-party payment institution; such routing is fragile and may create tax invoice mismatches. It is therefore not suitable as a primary clearing rail for a dental manufacturing WFOE. Use domestic tier-1 banks as the only fully compliant clearing rails.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is generally mandatory for first account activation. The statutory director, or at minimum a senior authorized signatory named in the board resolution, must appear in-branch with original identification documents. Remote consular proxy opening is not a recognized procedure under PBOC corporate account-opening rules for mainland WFOEs. The Taiwan-resident legal representative must present a valid passport and the Mainland Travel Permit for Taiwan Residents, or provide a notarized power of attorney to a local financial controller who appears in person. The bank compliance team will require the business license, articles of association, board resolution, company chops, beneficial ownership declaration, and a scheduled face-to-face interview. Video verification may be used as a supplement, but it does not fully replace the physical-branch requirement for the opening of the capital account and basic account.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership opacity through nominee layers among Taiwan, Hong Kong, and mainland holding structures.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized and apostilled certificates of incorporation for every entity in the ownership chain; current registry search reports; full shareholder register identifying natural-person ultimate beneficial owners through direct and indirect ownership percentages; government-issued passport and Mainland Travel Permit for Taiwan Residents; board resolution approving WFOE establishment; beneficial ownership declaration; audited financial statements of the ultimate parent; bank reference letter for the holding entity; corporate organizational chart.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade-based money laundering indicators from mismatched product value, quantity, or transportation routes on zirconia ceramic block exports and raw-material imports.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed sales and purchase contracts with Incoterms; itemized commercial invoices; packing lists; bill of lading or air waybill; PRC customs declaration records; HS, ISIC, and NAICS classification notes; product technical data sheets and batch certificates; independent laboratory or sterilization certificate for dental materials; corresponding SWIFT MT103 payment records on both inbound and outbound legs; reconciliation statement showing goods flow, fund flow, and customs declarations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions, adverse media, and PEP concerns involving cross-strait ownership or counterparties in sensitive jurisdictions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Completed sanctions screening results against OFAC, EU, UN, UK HM Treasury, PRC MOFCOM, PBOC, and other relevant lists; PEP and negative-news search output with source pages; sworn source-of-wealth and source-of-funds statement from the ultimate beneficial owner; bank statements and tax filings supporting accumulated wealth; audited financial statements of the Taiwanese parent; notarized Taiwan business registry certificate; written undertaking confirming no sanctioned persons or prohibited military or dual-use end-use.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Disproportionately large equity injection or urgent pre-export financing for the small-batch manufacture of dental CAD/CAM zirconia blocks.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed business plan with production capacity, projected utilization, and working-capital forecast; executed supplier contracts and equipment purchase pro-forma invoices; factory lease agreement and site inspection report; payroll register and social insurance contribution records; customer orders, letters of intent, or distribution agreements; board-approved budget and cash-flow plan; remitting investor's bank statements evidencing source of funds; confirmation of the local CPA's intended capital verification timeline.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant inbound capital injection rail for the Taiwan-owned WFOE: (1) Complete FDI foreign exchange registration through an SAFE-designated bank and obtain the FDI registration code. (2) Open a Foreign Exchange Capital Account in the WFOE's name at the same bank. (3) The Taiwanese shareholder remits the equity subscription via SWIFT MT103, with field 70 containing the FDI registration code and the purpose marked as foreign equity investment. (4) The receiving bank verifies that the remitter matches the registered overseas investor and that the board minutes and WFOE charter authorize the capital contribution. (5) The WFOE presents the bank with actual-burn documentation such as supplier contracts, lease agreements, payroll records, and purchase orders before converting foreign exchange into RMB under SAFE's real-use principle. (6) A Chinese certified public accountant issues the capital verification report after funds are credited and converted, which is then filed with the local Administration for Market Regulation. Large injections above USD 5 million may trigger enhanced due diligence, including source-of-wealth inquiry from the Taiwan investor.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound clearing rails for the WFOE's commercial trade include SWIFT MT103 telegraphic transfers for import advance payments and open-account transactions, supported by the import contract, supplier invoice, and where applicable the customs declaration. Commercial letters of credit, MT700 or MT707, are recommended for larger zirconia powder and milling-equipment purchases requiring transport document control. Documentary collections remain a viable low-risk settlement alternative for dental ceramic consumables. For export sales to overseas dental laboratories and distributors, the WFOE receives LC or TT settlements into its export proceeds current account; the bank reconciles each receipt against the corresponding goods customs declaration and SAFE trade monitoring data. Direct RMB clearing with Taiwan counterparties can be executed through Bank of China's Taipei branch or other RMB clearing participants, but the underlying trade must still be documented with SAFE trade registration codes and full invoice evidence. All treasury payments must include the correct purpose-of-payment code and be supported by complete order-to-cash documentation.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable FX forward contracts with a SAFE-licensed Chinese bank, backed by actual trade invoices and committed working-capital or trade-cycle exposures; speculative forwards are prohibited.
FX swaps for short-term liquidity matching between import payments and export receipts, used strictly to convert and re-convert RMB and foreign currency cash flows arising from genuine trade.
Cross-currency interest rate swaps (CCIRS) permitted only where the WFOE has an underlying foreign-currency loan or debt instrument with matched notional and maturity.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are not permissible for the onshore WFOE as a direct hedging instrument; the Taiwan parent may use offshore NDFs only to hedge its own CNY economic exposure outside mainland China, not to create a de facto onshore NDF market channel.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Enterprise Information Publicity Report (Corporate Annual Report)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) through the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 1 January to 30 June each calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing places the WFOE on the Operating Abnormal List within 10 working days after 30 June; if uncorrected for 3 consecutive years, the entity is entered into the Serious Dishonesty List and faces loss of enterprise credit eligibility, publicity sanctions, restricted government procurement and, ultimately, administrative revocation/registration cancellation by SAMR.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Foreign Investment Information Report (FDI Annual Report)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR), shared with the Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM) under the Foreign Investment Law
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 1 January to 30 June each calendar year, submitted together with the SAMR annual report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Under the Foreign Investment Law, failure to file or fraudulent filing leads to a rectification order and, if not cured, an administrative fine of up to RMB 100,000; repeated non-compliance can trigger inclusion in credit and sanction databases and reinforcement of the SAMR cancellation process.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Settlement and Financial Statement Filing Package
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Taxation Administration (STATAX) via the local competent tax authority
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 31 May (within 5 months after the accounting year-end); transfer pricing documentation submissions align with this window
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: A daily late-payment surcharge of 0.05% applies on underpaid tax; failure to file within prescribed time attracts a fixed non-filing penalty of up to RMB 10,000 and, for understatement, 50%-500% of the underpaid tax; continued default triggers enforcement measures, asset seizure, and criminal referral for tax evasion.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Medical Device Production Quality System Self-Inspection and NMPA License Compliance Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Medical Products Administration (NMPA) and provincial Medical Products Administration (local MPA)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually as part of the enterprise quality-system audit and, where required, before the production permit renewal window; the license itself remains valid for a maximum 5-year cycle.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain a valid production license, or to evidence annual quality-system compliance for the dental CAD/CAM zirconia block manufacturing process, suspends production and sales; continued non-compliance triggers NMPA recall orders, product clearance suspension, and license revocation/administrative shutdown.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Under the PRC Company Law and Accounting Law, every WFOE/LLC must annually engage an independent Chinese CPA to audit its financial statements; no revenue, balance-sheet, or headcount exemption is available to a foreign-invested enterprise. For quantitative classification purposes, a full certified audit is also mandatory when any of the following enterprise-distinction indicators is crossed: annual operating revenue above RMB 50 million, total assets above RMB 50 million, or workforce above 100 employees. Smaller WFOEs remain within the statutory audit regime solely by reason of their legal form and foreign-investment status.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: PRC Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises (ASBE/CAS), closely converged with IFRS; parent-group statutory pack may require IFRS or US GAAP reconciliation, and small/micro electing enterprises may use the Small Enterprise Accounting Standards (SEAS) where the WFOE is within the permitted size band.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The WFOE must update the SAMR registration and the internal statutory register of shareholders within 30 days of any shareholding transfer, increase, pledge, or change in ultimate beneficial ownership; an annual confirmation is embedded in the combined SAMR/MOFCOM Foreign Investment Information Report due by 30 June, which must disclose the ultimate investor(s), control chain, and beneficial ownership as at the reporting date. A Taiwan-domiciled ultimate shareholder, if acting through an approved cross-strait investment, remains subject to the separate Taiwan Investment Commission beneficial-ownership/approval-change notification requirements.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Equity Transfers and Pledges
Register of Ultimate Beneficial Ownership Information
